body:
Reported on 1.14.0, two requests on list settings:
- Closing sits near the top, after the list type; Leave is at the bottom. They are
  two stages of one thing (close, then leave), so they belong together.
- The closing help should say that agreeing to close locks your amounts: nothing
  that involves you can be added or changed after you vote.
Both clients; the help text in all nine languages on each.
title: expense lists: put closing next to leave, and say what voting locks
